{{Quote|By the Black Nebula, there have been rumors about such a rescue!|Crimson Jack|<ref name="SW11">[[Star Wars (1977) 11|''Star Wars'' (1977) 11]]</ref>}}
The '''Black Nebula''' was a [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] located in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]],<ref name="EAOC" /> in a region of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] known as [[Parfadi]].<ref name="TCSWE" />

The Black Nebula separated the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Arat Fraca]] and [[Motexx]]. It contained two supermassive [[Neutron star/Legends|neutron stars]], making travel in the nebula impossible.<ref name="SoL" /> The nebula was a hideout for rogue [[Starship/Legends|starship]] outfitters during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="AJ4">{{JournalCite|4|It's a Gambler's Life}}</ref> [[Crimson Jack/Legends|Crimson Jack]] was known to swear by the Black Nebula.<ref name="SW11" />
